patch_list: Experimental companion patch that keeps byAir's online Pro gates open without forcing the crash-prone global entitlement refresh path.
Suppresses the main byAir paywall, unlock banners, local user gating, and the notifications preferences "All" gate.

Removes byAir's forced-update screen ("Pack up for Update! 🚀" / "Update Now") by pinning its version gate to "no update required". byAir fetches a server-side minimum version code on launch and, if your build is older, blocks the whole app…
